title: ZeroClaw README
claims: ZeroClaw describes a single Rust-binary agent runtime with tools, channels, local Ollama, and configurable providers.
notes: Source claim only; no local install, binary-size, RSS, offline, or policy test.

title: ZeroClaw Cargo workspace manifest
claims: The pinned workspace declares Rust 1.96, version 0.8.7, MIT OR Apache-2.0, and numerous runtime/provider/memory/channel/tool crates.
notes: Workspace scale counters a simple single-small-binary inference.

title: IronClaw README
claims: IronClaw describes self-hosted sandboxed agents with a network-disabled sandbox and host model proxy.
notes: Project is labelled alpha; source claims require identical local proof.

title: IronClaw licensing
claims: The pinned README identifies AGPLv3 plus commercial licensing.
notes: License suitability needs legal review before any reuse.

title: PicoClaw README
claims: PicoClaw is a Go personal assistant and labels itself early rapid development; its advertised RAM figures are project claims.
notes: Advertised resource figures exclude a qualified Splyce workload, local model server, assets, and OS baseline.

title: PicoClaw Go module manifest
claims: The pinned module requires Go 1.25.13 and includes PTY, MCP, SQLite, cloud-provider, channel, and OAuth dependencies.
notes: Dependency list is a source observation, not an installed-size or egress measurement.

title: NanoClaw README
claims: NanoClaw describes per-agent Linux containers and a setup path that installs Node, pnpm, Docker, and a credential gateway.
notes: Messaging/container architecture is not a coding-CLI or local-only proof.

title: NanoClaw package manifest
claims: The pinned package declares Node >=22, TypeScript build scripts, SQLite dependency, and a CLI binary.
notes: No model role, local-only, lifecycle, or recovery result was run.

title: Moltis README
claims: Moltis describes a MIT Rust personal-agent server with sandboxed commands, local-model option, memory, MCP, SSH and messaging surfaces.
notes: Its messaging-server focus and large multi-crate workspace differ from a bounded coding CLI.

title: Moltis Cargo workspace manifest
claims: The pinned workspace contains 76 members across broad channel, browser, provider, memory, tool, gateway and session surfaces.
notes: Source structure is counterevidence to treating the full project as the lightest base.

title: OpenCrabs README
claims: OpenCrabs describes a Rust terminal agent with local LLM use, local persistence, tools, memory and multi-channel operation.
notes: Built-in and optional provider/network routes must be disabled and proven for an all-local profile.

title: OpenCrabs Cargo manifest
claims: The pinned package declares Rust 1.95, MIT, version 0.5.14, TUI, SQLite, HTTP and gateway dependencies.
notes: Single binary does not establish total deployed resource cost or local-only behavior.

title: Pi coding-agent README
claims: Pinned Pi exposes extensible interactive and headless coding-agent surfaces.
